single-point:api.title: Every request goes through one api
single-point:api.message: It runs 1 replica, and every request from Web goes through it: if it stops, Web gets nothing.
single-point:api.rationale: Redundancy is what turns one instance's availability into a service's: with two replicas, one can stop (a deploy, a crash, a node drained) while the other answers.
